edits.current: "checked-record": "Pass the generated record's runtime payload fields, without proof values. The selected Lean constructor checks each input and may normalize it; rejection identifies the parameter and constructor and preserves caller data. Results contain copied payload fields with proofs erased. Both ordinary and independently reviewed packages, including standalone result-only packages, passed installed checks. The tested frozen Ruby Packet carries a Fin 10 digit and a checked Nat Subtype word as exact Integer values. Holder nests Packet, and Choice::Packet carries it in the active Choice branch. Generated Ruby adapters apply the exact Packet and nested Word constructors selected at each direct, repeated, Array, List, Option, Product, Except, Holder and Choice input site. Rejected calls preserve the complete caller graph and later valid calls recover. Packet arrays and options returned by Lean contain proof-free payloads without input-constructor selections. The tested Span, Ticket and Stamped inheritance chain remains a chain of nested parent subobjects rather than flattened fields. Generated adapters preserve the parent aliases and public nominal identities, erase the ordered, linked and stamped proof fields, apply the exact per-site Span, Word, Ticket and Stamped constructors in dependency order, retain independent choices for repeated parameters, check the nested Fin 8 mark, preserve rejected caller values and recover on the next valid call. Full packages check inputs and proof-free results; result-only packages project the same inherited payloads without input-constructor metadata. The tested checked-record graphs preserve nominal identity through a self-recursive Packet and a mutually recursive Envelope ↔ Step pair, including aliases, Array and Option wrappers, active variant branches, exact Nat Subtype constructors and Fin 3 fields. Generated adapters validate every selected input site in dependency order, erase proof fields, expose constructor-free copied results, preserve rejected caller graphs and recover on the next valid call. Closed Bool, String and Nat indices remain authenticated metadata rather than Ruby record fields. Generated frozen records use exact Ruby Integer values for `count`, `size` and every `EmptySized.data` element. Full gems exercise exact per-site constructors, negative-Nat host refusal, unchanged rejected values, recovery and proof-free results; standalone result-only gems expose the same copied records without checked-input metadata. Proof-only Witness crosses as a frozen Ruby exact-class value with a nullary initializer and no fields. Token retains its UNIT value, Marker remains a distinct frozen class, nil and Some(Witness) remain distinct, arrays retain length, and Mark keeps its branch. Full gems validate exact classes, the nullary constructor and recovery; result-only gems project Lean-produced proof-erased values without input-constructor metadata."

Author roots are removed before offline installation; the unchanged public C caller is compiled once, its source is removed, and the resulting executable runs before and after moving the complete installed tree, giving two executions per selection. The full API checks direct and repeated parameters, Array, List, Option, Product, both Except branches, Holder.packet and the active Choice packet value field, including exact per-site constructors, normalization, complete rejected-input snapshots and recovery. Checked-record WIT/WASI acceptance covers the established top-level Interval, Sized 3 and Bounded 0 101 forms plus the tested acyclic Packet, Holder and Choice forms through Array, List, Option, Product and Except copied positions. Generic checked records, other index kinds, open dependent or zero-payload records, callbacks and owned positions remain unreviewed. Both author routes and full/result-only APIs reproduce complete WIT component archives from two author roots, remove author roots, install offline, compile one unchanged public C caller, remove its source, and execute it before and after physically relocating each installation. The compiler-free runs use Wasmtime 42.0.1 and wasm-tools 1.245.1 on Linux x64/glibc 2.36 with an explicit 2.36 package floor, 64-bit native machine words and a recorded 20.0 host-load admission ceiling. The component requires its packaged native Lean host and is not a standalone WASI command. The archive retains complete handoff archives, extracted package records, receipts, installed inventories, execution records and both producer and verifier source closures. GCC, wasm-tools and Wasmtime remain trusted toolchain inputs. Hosted glibc 2.38 release-floor acceptance remains assigned to the dedicated workflow. Constructor dispatch and peak memory are unmeasured. Additional inherited wit acceptance: The wit installed lane authenticates the ordinary full inherited checked-record package selection for wit-wasi. The full API checks valid, normalized, invalid parent, invalid child, alias, nested Fin, repeated-constructor and recovery cases before projecting proof-free results. Two independent author builds, source removal, offline installation, relocation and unchanged caller replay are retained where the host permits them. The fixture covers inherited parent subobjects, child checked fields, aliases, nested inheritance, repeated constructor selections, and constructor-free results. Ordinary and independently reviewed sources are exercised in full and result-only WIT/WASI component packages. Complete packages are reproduced from two author roots, installed offline, exercised before and after relocation, and checked at a glibc 2.38 release floor. The generated C host requires its packaged native Lean component runtime; it is not a standalone WASI command. Complete archives, receipts, source-free inventories, caller binaries, execution records, TAP, and producer/checker/archive source closures are retained. Compiler, operating-system, wasm-tools, Wasmtime, and C toolchain distributions remain trusted inputs. This archive establishes installed WIT/WASI behavior, not promotion into the public support inventory. Inherited checked-record acceptance covers only the tested acyclic Span → Ticket → Stamped chain, its Ticket alias, repeated direct parameters, nested parent constraints and proof-free Ticket/Stamped results. Value-carrying receiver-dependent inherited fields, generic or recursive inheritance, other index kinds, open dependent or zero-payload records, callbacks and owned positions remain unreviewed. Additional recursive wit acceptance: The wit installed lane authenticates the ordinary recursive recursive checked-record selection for wit-wasi. Original inputs, exact failures, preserved rejected values, recovery and proof-free results are retained; independently reproduced packages are installed without author sources and replayed after relocation where the host permits it. The fixtures cover self-recursive Packet and mutual Envelope/Step groups with Option and Array carriers. Checked fields are limited to Fin 3 and the tested plusOne/plusTwo Nat Subtype constructors. Each package is a copied-graph WIT component whose native host forwards exact refinement diagnostics as the final Wasmtime error cause; callbacks, resources and owned positions remain separate work. The component requires its packaged native Lean host and is not a standalone WASI command. Accepted cells come from serial attempts r2 and r3 at one frozen revision; r1 and the r2 reviewed-mutual cell refused on disk and load guards and are retained only as observations. These local Linux x64/glibc 2.36 runs do not establish hosted release-floor acceptance. Constructor dispatch and peak memory are unmeasured. Recursive checked-record acceptance covers the tested Packet self-cycle and Envelope ↔ Step mutual cycle, their aliases, Array/Option wrappers, active branches, Nat Subtype constructors and Fin 3 fields in copied parameters, results and fields. It does not establish generic recursive records, other recursive graph shapes, value-carrying receiver-dependent fields, other index kinds, open dependent or zero-payload records, callbacks or owned positions. It does not establish generic recursive records, other recursive graph shapes, value-carrying receiver-dependent fields, other index kinds, open dependent or zero-payload records, callbacks or owned positions. Additional hosted closed-index acceptance: Hosted GitHub Actions run 39373895062 rebuilt this full ordinary-source WIT/WASI component selection on Ubuntu 24.04. Two author roots reproduce the complete component archive, remove author roots, install offline, compile one unchanged public C caller, remove its source, relocate the installation and replay its binary through Wasmtime. The full API exercises all eight checked inputs, exact constructor refusals, unchanged rejected values, recovery and all eight proof-free indexed results. The archive authenticates the original workflow, job, artifact, toolchain log, TAP, reports, package receipt, component archive and exact source identities. Full components cover parameters and results; standalone result-only components cover results only. Open or opaque indices; Int, Char, fixed-width and platform-width integers, Fin, functions, proofs, instances and other index kinds; checked-record fields, callbacks and owned positions; value-carrying dependent payloads; and zero-payload checked records remain unreviewed here. Each component requires its packaged native Lean host and is not a standalone WASI command. Complete component archives, receipts, generated projections, caller binaries, reports, execution records, original workflow records and source closures are retained; external Lean, Nix, C, wasm-tools, Wasmtime and operating-system toolchains remain trusted recorded inputs. Other host targets require separate installed evidence. Two independent author roots reproduced the complete prepared package before author removal, source-free offline installation and unchanged replay after physical relocation. The package runs the selected nullary Witness constructor at every checked input, keeps rejected values unchanged, recovers on the next valid call and projects proof-erased results. The retained archive authenticates every original artifact byte, route result, caller observation and exact producer, consumer, checker and archiver source closure. Hosted zero-payload WIT/WASI acceptance covers only the retained Witness, Token, Marker, Option, Array and Mark fixtures at copied parameter and result sites in four ordinary/reviewed full/result-only packages. It does not promote checked-record fields, callbacks, owned positions, other zero-payload shapes, PHP-Wasm or another host. External Lean, consumer-language, package-manager and operating-system toolchains remain trusted recorded inputs."

A Holder record nests Packet, and the packet case of Choice carries it in its active branch. Generated WIT adapters apply the exact Packet and nested Word constructors selected at each direct, repeated, Array, List, Option, Product, Except, Holder and Choice input site. Rejected calls preserve the complete caller value tree and output sentinel, and later valid calls recover. Packet arrays and options returned by Lean contain proof-free WIT records without input-constructor selections. The tested Span, Ticket and Stamped inheritance chain remains a chain of nested parent subobjects rather than flattened fields. Generated adapters preserve the parent aliases and public nominal identities, erase the ordered, linked and stamped proof fields, apply the exact per-site Span, Word, Ticket and Stamped constructors in dependency order, retain independent choices for repeated parameters, check the nested Fin 8 mark, preserve rejected caller values and recover on the next valid call. Full packages check inputs and proof-free results; result-only packages project the same inherited payloads without input-constructor metadata. The tested checked-record graphs preserve nominal identity through a self-recursive Packet and a mutually recursive Envelope ↔ Step pair, including aliases, Array and Option wrappers, active variant branches, exact Nat Subtype constructors and Fin 3 fields. Generated adapters validate every selected input site in dependency order, erase proof fields, expose constructor-free copied results, preserve rejected caller graphs and recover on the next valid call. Closed Bool, String and Nat indices remain authenticated metadata rather than WIT record fields. Generated records expose Nat payloads such as `count`, `size` and every `EmptySized.data` element as exact little-endian `list<u32>` limbs. Full components exercise exact per-site constructors, malformed-Nat host refusal, unchanged rejected values, recovery and proof-free results; standalone result-only components expose the same copied records without checked-input metadata. Proof-only Witness follows the generator's WIT empty-carrier convention as enum witness { empty }; this is a representation choice, not a Lean semantic distinction. Token remains record token { tag: unit }, Marker uses its own empty enum, option presence, list length and Mark branches remain explicit. Full component packages validate the nullary checked constructor and recovery; result-only packages project Lean-produced proof-erased values without input-constructor metadata."

edits.current: "checked-record": "Pass the generated record's runtime payload fields, without proof values. The selected Lean constructor checks each input and may normalize it; rejection identifies the parameter and constructor and preserves caller data. Results contain copied payload fields with proofs erased. Both ordinary and independently reviewed packages, including standalone result-only packages, passed installed checks. The tested Component Model Packet is a WIT record whose Fin 10 digit and checked Nat Subtype word are canonical list<u32> limbs. A Holder record nests Packet, and the packet case of Choice carries it in its active branch. Generated WIT adapters apply the exact Packet and nested Word constructors selected at each direct, repeated, Array, List, Option, Product, Except, Holder and Choice input site. Rejected calls preserve the complete caller value tree and output sentinel, and later valid calls recover. Packet arrays and options returned by Lean contain proof-free WIT records without input-constructor selections. The tested Span, Ticket and Stamped inheritance chain remains a chain of nested parent subobjects rather than flattened fields. Generated adapters preserve the parent aliases and public nominal identities, erase the ordered, linked and stamped proof fields, apply the exact per-site Span, Word, Ticket and Stamped constructors in dependency order, retain independent choices for repeated parameters, check the nested Fin 8 mark, preserve rejected caller values and recover on the next valid call. Full packages check inputs and proof-free results; result-only packages project the same inherited payloads without input-constructor metadata. The tested checked-record graphs preserve nominal identity through a self-recursive Packet and a mutually recursive Envelope ↔ Step pair, including aliases, Array and Option wrappers, active variant branches, exact Nat Subtype constructors and Fin 3 fields. Generated adapters validate every selected input site in dependency order, erase proof fields, expose constructor-free copied results, preserve rejected caller graphs and recover on the next valid call. Closed Bool, String and Nat indices remain authenticated metadata rather than WIT record fields. Generated records expose Nat payloads such as `count`, `size` and every `EmptySized.data` element as exact little-endian `list<u32>` limbs. Full components exercise exact per-site constructors, malformed-Nat host refusal, unchanged rejected values, recovery and proof-free results; standalone result-only components expose the same copied records without checked-input metadata. Proof-only Witness follows the generator's WIT empty-carrier convention as enum witness { empty }; this is a representation choice, not a Lean semantic distinction. Token remains record token { tag: unit }, Marker uses its own empty enum, option presence, list length and Mark branches remain explicit. Full component packages validate the nullary checked constructor and recovery; result-only packages project Lean-produced proof-erased values without input-constructor metadata."

Token retains its Unit value, Marker remains a distinct blessed class, undef stays distinct from a present Witness, arrays retain length, and Mark keeps its branch. Full CPAN packages validate exact classes across four ABI interpreters, the nullary constructor and recovery; result-only packages project Lean-produced proof-erased values without input-constructor metadata."

Two independent author builds, source removal, offline installation, relocation and unchanged caller replay are retained where the host permits them. Ordinary and independently reviewed sources are exercised in full and result-only npm packages. Node JavaScript, strict TypeScript, Chromium, Firefox and WebKit execute source-free installed packages; browser contexts cover plain pages, React production and StrictMode, and dedicated workers. Complete component/runtime npm archives, installed receipts, reports, controls, TAP streams and browser observations are retained. Browser binaries and generated deployment directories are represented by their recorded identities and observations. The evidence applies to the exact Linux x64 Node and browser versions recorded in this index. Other hosts require independent installed acceptance. Value-carrying receiver-dependent inherited fields, generic or recursive inheritance, other index kinds, open dependent or zero-payload records, callbacks and owned positions remain unreviewed. Open or opaque indices; Int, Char, fixed-width and platform-width integers, Fin, functions, proofs, instances and other index kinds; checked-record fields, callbacks and owned positions; value-carrying dependent payloads; and zero-payload checked records remain unreviewed here.
